propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event in .tickets-tracker causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with reducer-error, surfacing as an INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets in the same relation graph.

An orphan event-less directory is reachable only via walking the relation graph of an unrelated ticket, yet the failure is reported against the orphan's ID rather than the ticket being reviewed, creating wrong-direction debugging signals.
Empty ticket directories are invisible to git and cannot be gitignored, so they persist in local clones indefinitely and cannot be repaired by pulling shared history.

The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a named warning, rather than failing the entire snapshot, to unblock plan reviews on unrelated tickets in affected clones.

The writer should continue creating ticket directories before their first event to avoid a race-unsafe cleanup window; reader-side tolerance fixes both new and pre-existing orphans without introducing concurrency hazards.
